<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919765_theRebbe_137" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919765_theRebbe_137__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>These three levels of nullification in light also have parallels in divine service, corresponding to the nullifications of comprehension based on faith, faith itself, and self-sacrifice.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, these three levels of nullification in light</t>
    <t s="2">also have</t>
    <t s="3">(their parallel)</t>
    <t s="4">in the service of man.</t>
    <t s="5">And based on what was brought above from the maamar, that these three levels of nullification in light are in Binah, Chochmah, and Keter,</t>
    <t s="6">it can be said</t>
    <t s="7">that these three nullifications in divine service are the nullification of comprehension founded upon faith,</t>
    <t s="8">the nullification of faith, and the nullification of self-sacrifice.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even when the encompassing light is drawn into the internal, it remains in its essence as encompassing, as seen in the examples of will clothing in intellect and faith clothing in intellect.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this will be understood based on what is explained elsewhere</t>
    <t s="1">regarding the matter of the encompassing and the internal,</t>
    <t s="2">that even when the encompassing is drawn and clothes itself within the internal,</t>
    <t s="3">it remains in its essence,</t>
    <t s="4">encompassing.</t>
    <t s="5">[And likewise regarding the clothing of light in vessels</t>
    <t s="6">(where the light in itself is encompassing, and through its clothing in vessels it becomes internal light),</t>
    <t s="7">that even after the light clothes itself in vessels, it remains in its essence,</t>
    <t s="8">light.</t>
    <t s="9">And analogously with will,</t>
    <t s="10">that even after it is drawn and clothes itself in intellect, to the point that it tilts the intellect to be according to the will and becomes a reason for the will,</t>
    <t s="11">nevertheless it remains in its essence,</t>
    <t s="12">a will that is above reason.</t>
    <t s="13">And likewise regarding the clothing of faith in intellect,</t>
    <t s="14">for when one contemplates in his intellect a matter that he believes in</t>
    <t s="15">(with simple faith that is above intellect)</t>
    <t s="16">in order that also in his intellect he will understand the matter,</t>
    <t s="17">even after he understands the matter in his intellect,</t>
    <t s="18">his faith remains faith that is above intellect.</t>
    <t s="19">And the difference between these two analogies is,</t>
    <t s="20">that in the analogy of the clothing of will in intellect,</t>
    <t s="21">the fact that the intellect understands according to the will is not from the side of the intellect, but from the side of the will that tilts the intellect and changes it.</t>
    <t s="22">And since the clothing of will in intellect is in a manner that the intellect is nullified</t>
    <t s="23">(changed)</t>
    <t s="24">before the will,</t>
    <t s="25">therefore,</t>
    <t s="26">that the clothing does not effect a change in the will</t>
    <t s="27">(that even after its clothing in intellect it remains in its existence),</t>
    <t s="28">is not so novel.</t>
    <t s="29">And in the clothing of faith in intellect,</t>
    <t s="30">the fact that the intellect reaches the conclusion that the matter he believes in is true also from the side of the intellect,</t>
    <t s="31">is from the side of the intellect</t>
    <t s="32">[for when he contemplates in his intellect in order that also his intellect will be according to the truth,</t>
    <t s="33">he strives that his contemplation and reasoning be according to the truth of the intellect],</t>
    <t s="34">and nevertheless the clothing does not effect a change in the faith,</t>
    <t s="35">and even after he understands the matter in his intellect</t>
    <t s="36">(from the side of the intellect),</t>
    <t s="37">his faith is faith that is above intellect.</t>
    <t s="38">And another difference between the two analogies,</t>
    <t s="39">that in the clothing of will in intellect,</t>
    <t s="40">that the will clothes itself in intellect and acts upon it to be according to the will is because the will rules over the intellect</t>
    <t s="41">(and not that this affects the will).</t>
    <t s="42">And since that the will rules over the intellect is</t>
    <t s="43">(not the will itself,</t>
    <t s="44">but rather)</t>
    <t s="45">its relationship to the other faculties,</t>
    <t s="46">therefore the descent of the will and its clothing in intellect is a true descent</t>
    <t s="47">(a departure from will to intellect).</t>
    <t s="48">And in the clothing of faith in intellect,</t>
    <t s="49">that he contemplates in his intellect in order to understand the matter is for the sake of faith,</t>
    <t s="50">in order that his faith will also be in internality.</t>
    <t s="51">Therefore the descent of faith and its clothing in intellect is not a true descent.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Since faith is nullification and intellect is existence, the clothing of faith in intellect draws nullification into existence, yet the nullification remains in full force, differing only in that the nullification of clothed faith is in a form of revealed existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on the known principle</t>
    <t s="1">that faith is nullification and intellect is existence,</t>
    <t s="2">it is understood</t>
    <t s="3">that the matter of the clothing of faith in intellect is that nullification is drawn into existence.</t>
    <t s="4">And since his contemplation</t>
    <t s="5">(and comprehension)</t>
    <t s="6">is for the sake of faith</t>
    <t s="7">[and also that the intellect remains in its existence and is not nullified before faith</t>
    <t s="8">(as it is nullified before will)</t>
    <t s="9">is for the sake of faith,</t>
    <t s="10">in order that also the intellect, as it is in its existence, will be according to faith],</t>
    <t s="11">therefore even after the nullification of faith is drawn into the existence of intellect,</t>
    <t s="12">the nullification is in its full strength.</t>
    <t s="13">And the difference between the nullification of faith that clothes itself in intellect and the nullification of faith that is above intellect is,</t>
    <t s="14">that the nullification of faith that clothes itself in intellect comes in a form of revelation</t>
    <t s="15">(that the nullification is revealed in intellect),</t>
    <t s="16">existence.</t>
    <t s="17">For in addition to the fact that the intellect</t>
    <t s="18">(in which faith clothes itself)</t>
    <t s="19">is existence,</t>
    <t s="20">also the revelation of faith</t>
    <t s="21">(that faith is in revelation in a manner that it is felt in the intellect)</t>
    <t s="22">is existence.</t>
    <t s="23">And the nullification of faith that is above intellect is above the existence of revelation.</t>
    <t s="24">[Analogous to the difference between the nullification of light that clothes itself in vessels and the nullification of light that is above clothing,</t>
    <t s="25">that even the light that clothes itself in vessels is not an existence unto itself, and its entire matter is the revelation of the Luminary.</t>
    <t s="26">Rather, the nullification of light that clothes itself is in a form of revelation,</t>
    <t s="27">existence.</t>
    <t s="28">For in addition to the fact that the vessels in which the light clothes itself are existence,</t>
    <t s="29">also the revelation of the light</t>
    <t s="30">(that is revealed in the vessels)</t>
    <t s="31">is existence.</t>
    <t s="32">And the nullification of light that is above clothing is that it does not have even the existence of revelation].</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
